Haan, MOR 41 matches. But I'm a bit worried, I just got a message asking for ₹12,000 to get my commission, is that normal?
What's this payment for, and is anyone on another call telling you what to do?

A genuine company offering a job will never ask you for money. Do you need to make this payment to get paid for work or tasks?
Arre, that makes sense, I don’t have to pay anything to earn. I’ll stop this right now, thanks for warning me.
